newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden EMU entry seen tied to politics not finance.
newsitem.headline: Sweden EMU entry seen tied to politics not finance.

text.p: Sweden's prospects of entry to Europe's economic and monetary union (EMU) hang largely on a domestic political decision as it will probably meet all convergence criteria in time, Sweden's EU council general director said on Tuesday.

"I think that Sweden will fulfill all the convergence criteria and so it is very much dependent on what the political decision is," general director Sixten Korkman told a seminar on EMU and Swedish business.
Korkman said constitutional problems could also prove problematic for Sweden in meeting the start-up of EMU on January 1, 1999.
But Korkman said it was possible Sweden would enter EMU later.

"If EMU, as I believe, starts on time and is a successful project, that will create a favourable climate for Sweden to join at a later occasion," he said. -- Peter Fellman, Stockholm newsroom +46-8--700 1007
